All Rise (2019) is a legal drama series following Lola Carmichael, a newly appointed judge in Los Angeles who refuses to let the courtroom become just another routine workplace. After years as a dedicated prosecutor, Lola steps behind the bench and finds herself responsible for making difficult decisions that can change people’s lives.
Working alongside lawyers, defendants, court officers, and her longtime colleagues, Lola faces complicated cases that challenge her sense of justice. She must remain fair and professional while dealing with emotional testimony, conflicting arguments, and the pressure that comes with being a judge.
The series explores themes of justice, morality, responsibility, equality, and the human side of the legal system. Lola’s experience as a former prosecutor gives her a unique perspective, but it also forces her to understand that every case has multiple sides.
What makes All Rise interesting is its focus on the people behind the courtroom arguments. The decisions made inside the courthouse affect families, careers, and entire lives, making every case more than just a legal battle.
More than just a courtroom series, All Rise follows a judge trying to balance the law with compassion while navigating the complicated realities of the justice system.
💬 Can Lola remain completely fair when every case comes with its own human story?
